title: Test one interface declaration shape
objective: Test whether one isolated Agent can deepen the existing declaration normalizer to support bounded exported interfaces while preserving every accepted function and type-alias result.
requirements: The module keeps one pure function that accepts one TypeScript declaration string, uses the pinned OXC parser entirely in memory, and performs no filesystem, environment, project, package, command, preparation, Runner, or candidate work.

The function preserves every accepted function and type-alias result and also accepts exactly one named exported nongeneric interface with no heritage and only ordered identifier-named property signatures using the already supported annotation shapes.

A supported interface returns its exact name, empty type-parameter and heritage lists, and ordered property members with name, optional, readonly, and normalized annotation fields; formatting differences produce byte-identical JSON output.
Invalid syntax, unsupported declarations or interface members, and interface properties without explicit annotations return the exact typed findings and messages defined by the Agent Brief.

files.task: Deepen the existing declaration normalizer through its one public function. Preserve every accepted function and type-alias result and add one deterministic interface shape for the reviewed property-only subset. Do not add another public function or expand into interface methods, heritage, generics, closure, routing, provenance, digests, preparation, Runner integration, or candidate verification.

owns.description: Parses one declaration string and returns one deterministic, body-free shape for the supported exported function, type alias, or property-only interface, or one precise typed finding.

context.purpose: Show the pinned OXC parse call and the repository's defensive AST-record handling. Reuse only the small parsing patterns needed for one in-memory string; do not copy file inspection, closure, import, or export-discovery behavior.
Confirm the pinned oxc-parser version and the repository's ESM TypeScript conventions.
Confirm the strict NodeNext TypeScript settings the module must compile under.

constraints: Import parseSync directly from `oxc-parser` and parse the supplied string as a TypeScript module. Treat any parser error diagnostic as `{ status: "invalid", finding: { code: "DECLARATION_SYNTAX_INVALID", message: "The declaration is not valid TypeScript syntax." } }` before inspecting its shape.

After syntax succeeds, require a Program body containing exactly one ExportNamedDeclaration with no source and no export specifiers. Its declaration must be one named FunctionDeclaration or TSTypeAliasDeclaration already supported by revision 3, or one TSInterfaceDeclaration supported by this revision. Reject every other declaration or export form as `{ status: "invalid", finding: { code: "DECLARATION_SHAPE_UNSUPPORTED", message: "Expected exactly one supported exported declaration." } }`.

Preserve all revision 3 function and type-alias behavior, output shapes, field order, findings, and messages exactly. Reuse the existing primitive, unqualified reference without type arguments, and flat ordered union annotation rules for supported interface properties.

For a TSInterfaceDeclaration, require an Identifier name, null typeParameters, an empty extends array, and a TSInterfaceBody. Accept an empty body. Otherwise require every ordered body member to be a TSPropertySignature with computed false, an Identifier key, static false, null accessibility, and an explicit typeAnnotation. Reject generics, heritage, methods, call signatures, index signatures, computed or non-Identifier property names, and every other member shape with DECLARATION_SHAPE_UNSUPPORTED and the exact supported-declaration message.

If an otherwise supported interface property has no explicit typeAnnotation, return `{ status: "invalid", finding: { code: "DECLARATION_CONTRACT_INCOMPLETE", message: "Every interface property must have an explicit supported type." } }` before normalizing property annotations. Unsupported explicit annotations still return DECLARATION_SHAPE_UNSUPPORTED.

Return interface success fields in exactly this insertion order: status, shape; the interface shape uses kind, name, typeParameters, extends, members; each member uses kind, name, optional, readonly, typeAnnotation. Set kind to `interface`, typeParameters and extends to new empty arrays, member kind to `property`, and preserve source member and union order.

Do not return AST nodes, source offsets, comments, diagnostics, thrown parser errors, or mutable parser-owned objects. Do not read or write files, inspect the repository, load configuration or environment variables, spawn commands, or import any SCORE module.

Export only `normalizeDeclarationShape`; keep every helper type and function private so `inspect-module --export normalizeDeclarationShape --closure` closes the complete public contract without unresolved private names.

Make no unrelated cleanup or refactor. This revision changes only the previously unsupported reviewed interface subset and its missing-property-annotation finding; all previously accepted and rejected inputs remain unchanged.
